mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routes (user_id, route_name, duration_days, total_distance, mode, pace, interests, waypoints, polyline) VALUES (#{userId}, #{routeName}, #{durationDays}, #{totalDistance}, #{mode}, #{pace}, #{interests, typeHandler=com.travelgd.handler.JsonListStringHandler}, #{waypoints, typeHandler=com.travelgd.handler.JsonWaypointListHandler}, #{polyline, typeHandler=com.travelgd.handler.JsonCoordinateListHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM routes WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM routes WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routes WHERE user_id = #{userId}
